name: Local LLM Inference
outcome: Run an existing language model locally and assess resource needs.
description: Run a small existing language model in a local inference runtime. Query its endpoint from Python, compare inference settings and resource use, and record the model version, license and runtime configuration.
external: Python or CLI, package environments, basic hardware concepts and sufficient local memory for the selected model.
prior: Basic hardware concepts and sufficient local memory
learn: Load an existing open-weight LLM and query its local endpoint programmatically
Compare resource use and quantization trade-offs
Record model format, settings and performance
moduleDescriptions: Compare open-weight model formats, licenses and runtime compatibility.
Start a local runtime and query its endpoint from Python; inspect CPU/GPU memory use.
Compare supplied quantized variants and configure decoding settings.
Measure latency and output quality on a fixed test set and document results.
prerequisiteRationale: A01 supplies programmatic model interaction; M03 shifts the endpoint to a local inference runtime.
